content.comment_body: Is the cable for connecting a [version_no] PLC to an old [version_no] TD display still obtainable? Alternatively, does anyone have a wiring diagram for this connection?
These components are only available second-hand. An official circuit diagram was never released.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are searching for ways to connect older displays with newer modules in the [product_name] product line but encounter obstacles such as missing official documentation and difficulty finding compatible hardware. The lack of a published wiring diagram and the fact that cables are no longer produced make integration of legacy and newer devices challenging.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [company_name] to offer official connection hardware or, at minimum, wiring diagrams to support integration of older and newer [product_name] modules.
pain_keywords: lack of support for old products
